items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: they had Cozy Cole, Clyde Hart, I think Al Hall, Jonah Jones.

ctx.x: To see his wife. He missed his wife,

and instead of sending for her he just turned around and went back to see her. And it brought everybody up -- it made a federal case out of it, and the guys were suspended for a year, and it was Stuff's fault, because they had Cozy Cole, Clyde Hart, I think Al Hall, Jonah Jones. They had guys that were quite prominent in those days, you know?
And the whole group got suspended because of what Stuff did.
